title: Late Cancellation and No-Show Hours in a Personal Services Plan Use Review
content:
When the use of a Personal Services Plan is measured to find the package that fits it, hours owed for late cancellations and no-shows can count as use.

## Rule

Hours drawn or charged for late cancellations and no-shows with a posting date in the review months are added to the hours used in full where there are at least two such entries, at 0.5 of their hours where there is exactly one, and not at all where there is none.

**Entries counted.** Each hours entry posted on the plan's ledger for an order with the reason late cancellation or no-show counts as one entry — whether the hours were drawn from the plan's available hours or charged at the hourly rate — where its posting date falls within the review months (fewer than 3 whole months before the request).

## Ladder

| Late-cancellation and no-show hours entries in the review months | Hours added to the hours used |
|---|---|
| Two or more | All of their hours |
| Exactly one | 0.5 of its hours |
| None | None |

## Hypothetical cases

- Two entries of 1.0 and 0.5 hour: 1.5 hours added.
- One entry of 1.0 hour: 0.5 hour added.
- Three entries of 0.5 hour each: 1.5 hours added.
- No entry: nothing added.
